
== Build notes ==
New encyclopedia entry for Lucasfilm's 1996 campaign (novel, Dark Horse comic, N64/Windows game, McNeely score, Kenner/Topps/RPG). Title is a parenthetical dab so the cancelled-expansion title stays Shadows of the Empire. Hardcover day: Wikipedia 1 April 1996, Thrillist a week after the 23 April soundtrack, Wookieepedia May 1996; body dests 1996 without a day. Trailer: Cavalcade of Awesome says US conventions then pulled; Thrillist records a QVC airing. Both dested. Decipher published no moved-card list. multimedia dest 24 October 2026.
